subject: microbiology
title: Candida albicans, Germ Tube, Thrush, Vaginitis and Candidaemia

steps.tx: **Candida albicans** is a commensal yeast of mouth, gut and vagina that becomes pathogenic when mucosa, immunity or microbiota are disturbed. The germ tube test identifies presumptive C. albicans: yeast incubated in serum at 37 degrees produces true hyphal outgrowths without constriction within two to three hours. Candida dubliniensis can also be germ-tube positive, a classic refinement.
steps.say: A germ tube in serum names presumptive Candida albicans within hours.

vis.caption: Candida albicans budding oval blastoconidia and elongated pseudohyphae demonstrated in clinical exudate [Credit: Ajay Kumar, StewardMD cleared]

steps.tx: **Oral candidiasis** or thrush forms removable white plaques on tongue and buccal mucosa over an erythematous base, unlike leukoplakia which cannot be scraped off. It signals antibiotics, inhaled steroids, diabetes or cellular immune defects; new thrush in an adult warrants HIV and glucose assessment. Angular cheilitis and denture stomatitis are related Candida syndromes in moist oral niches.
steps.say: Thrush scrapes off and bleeds slightly; leukoplakia stays fixed.

points: Hairy leukoplakia on lateral tongue in HIV
Aphthous ulcers are discrete and painful

steps.tx: White curd like plaques on the tongue and buccal mucosa wipe away and leave a red base, unlike leukoplakia, which stays fixed. **Oral candidiasis** follows antibiotics, inhaled steroids, diabetes, or a defect of cellular immunity. Thrush appearing for the first time in an adult should prompt checks for HIV and for raised glucose. Angular cheilitis and denture stomatitis are related Candida problems in moist corners of the mouth. Scraping is the bedside distinction.
steps.say: Thrush forms white plaques that scrape off and leave a slightly bleeding red base. Leukoplakia does not scrape off. New thrush in an adult calls for assessment of HIV, diabetes, recent antibiotics, and inhaled steroids.

vis.alt: Curd like white plaques of oral thrush coat the buccal mucosa.
vis.caption: Soft white plaques sit on red buccal mucosa and can be wiped away, which is the appearance of thrush. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Vulvovaginal candidiasis** causes itching, burning and thick curdy discharge with vaginal erythema, typically without odour and with normal vaginal pH, separating it from bacterial vaginosis and trichomoniasis. Recurrent disease means four or more episodes yearly and requires culture for non-albicans species and diabetes review. Azoles treat uncomplicated episodes; oral fluconazole is avoided in pregnancy in favour of topical therapy.
steps.say: Itch, curd and normal pH name Candida in vaginal discharge.

left.title: Candida pattern
points: pH usually below four point five

right.title: Other vaginitis
points: Raised pH favours BV or trichomonas

steps.tx: **Candidaemia** is Candida in blood, usually from central venous catheters, abdominal surgery, broad-spectrum antibiotics, parenteral nutrition or neutropenia. Blood cultures miss a substantial fraction of invasive candidiasis, so persistent fever in a high-risk ICU patient needs ophthalmology, catheter review, repeat cultures and empiric echinocandin consideration. Candida in blood is never dismissed as contamination because endocarditis, endophthalmitis and deep seeding follow.
steps.say: Candida growing from blood always demands action, never a contamination label.

right.title: Response
points: Start echinocandin in most ICU candidaemia
Remove or replace central catheter where feasible

steps.tx: **Chromogenic Candida media** and MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry speed species identification by colony colour or protein fingerprint, while germ tube and chlamydospore formation on cornmeal agar remain low-cost albicans clues. Species matters because Candida krusei is intrinsically fluconazole resistant, Candida glabrata has dose-dependent or resistant azole patterns, and Candida parapsilosis has higher echinocandin MICs linked to its FKS sequence.
steps.say: In Candida, the species name predicts the resistance trap.

right.title: Resistance clues
points: Auris may resist all three major classes

steps.tx: Beta glucan is a **pan-fungal blood marker** raised in many invasive Candida, Aspergillus and Pneumocystis infections but absent or low in cryptococcosis and mucormycosis because their walls expose less of it. It supports, never proves, invasive candidiasis and has false positives from haemodialysis membranes, gauze and some blood products. Culture and clinical syndrome remain the arbiters of therapy.
steps.say: Beta glucan broadens fungal suspicion but cannot name the fungus.

nodes.label: Remove line search eye and heart seeding

steps.tx: Definitive species confirmation of Candida albicans on Dalmau cornmeal agar with Tween-80 relies on demonstrating thick-walled **chlamydospores** formed terminally on pseudohyphae. Incubation under a coverslip at twenty-five degrees restricts oxygen, stimulating robust pseudohyphal elongation and clusters of spherical refractile survival chlamydospores. Among medical yeasts, only Candida albicans and Candida dubliniensis routinely form these diagnostic terminal chlamydospores.
steps.say: Terminal chlamydospores develop on cornmeal agar with Tween under coverslip microaerophilic conditions.

rows: Positive, often in pairs or triplets

steps.tx: In invasive candidiasis or candidal septic shock in neutropenic hosts, **echinocandin antifungals** including caspofungin, micafungin, and anidulafungin serve as first-line empiric agents over fluconazole. Echinocandins non-competitively inhibit 1,3-beta-D-glucan synthase, halting cell wall biosynthesis and causing fungicidal lysis of Candida species. Transition to oral fluconazole occurs only after blood cultures clear and antimicrobial susceptibility testing confirms azole sensitivity.
steps.say: Echinocandins target beta glucan synthase to provide fungicidal bactericidal killing in candidal sepsis.

nodes.label: Blood cultures grow yeast from central line
Initiate empiric IV echinocandin (caspofungin or micafungin)
Step down to oral fluconazole after species identification and clearance
